title: Instant replay from Pause and race results
summary: Solo and split-screen riders can replay the last 30 seconds from Pause or from the results screen. Replay has play and pause, slow motion, skips, a draggable scrub bar and three cameras: Chase, Trackside and Orbit. Photo mode opens from a paused replay.
details: Replay plays the last 30 seconds and opens 15 s before the pause. Speeds: 1×, ½× and ¼×. Skips are 2 s. Keys, pad and touch controls are all wired up.
Chase is the ride's own camera as it was. Trackside sits beside the line the rider takes. Orbit circles the rider slowly.
Back returns to Pause or to the results. The ride resumes exactly where it was.
It works by replaying stored draw positions, not by re-running the simulation. So the race itself cannot change, and every rider plays back without re-running the CPUs.
Cost: about 1.3 MB for 30 s solo and about 8 MB in a six-rider race.
limitation: No sound during replay. Wheel dust, crash debris, blood and other particles stay as they were at the pause. Online rooms have no replay. There is no full-race replay and no freeze camera yet.
caption: Replay in the Chase camera, 4.8 s before the pause, with the controls along the bottom.
verification: Unit tests for the recorder (30 Hz sampling, blending, ring wrap, restart, rider growth) and for playback (speeds, end, seek, controller input), and a scrub bar layout test. tools/test_engine_replay.mjs passes locally on desktop and phone sizes. make precheck passes. Screenshots were checked by eye.
